description: Record only one part of the narration again, keeping the other parts' audio, the same as re-recording one block in the Voiceover panel. Uses 1 voice generation once approved. The voice stays the recording's voice: to change the voice, record the whole script (request_voiceover_audio). On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.
name: rerecord_narration_section
title: Record one part again
